title: Racial Bias in Hate Speech and Abusive Language Detection Datasets
reasoning: The paper identifies and measures racial bias, which is an ethical problem related to fairness and discrimination in AI systems. However, it does not primarily evaluate or benchmark different ethical frameworks, moral philosophies, or religious concepts themselves. Its main focus is on detecting and quantifying an ethical failure (bias) within machine learning models, rather than on the study of ethics or faith as a core subject.
